name: restart_core_service
description: Start, stop, or restart a core service (isy, udx, eisyui, mosquitto.ud, etc.) -- not plugin services, use plugin_ops for those. Call get_core_services_status first to see the exact service names and current status, and match the one that corresponds to what the customer means -- never guess or invent a service name. Only after the customer has explicitly agreed, never speculatively (stopping/restarting interrupts the service while it's down).

service.description: The exact service name, exactly as shown by get_core_services_status -- never invented.
